//buildCommand: Runs build:assets (reveal island + local engine) THEN copies public/ → dist-static/. Pointing this at `node scripts/build-static.mjs` alone was the root cause of the stale-bundle bug in DIAGNOSIS.md §2: that script only copies files, so a committed bundle survived every source edit. Both generated bundles are now gitignored and produced here. build-static.mjs additionally FAILS the build if any required artifact is missing, so an incomplete deploy can never reach production again.
//functions: api/[[...route]].ts mounts the REAL src/api/index.ts Hono app as an Edge Function, deployed alongside the static output. This is what makes the env keys in .env.example actually DO something on this host: previously outputDirectory was pure static, so nothing executed server-side, no secret was ever read, and every keyed panel was permanently stuck on its deterministic fallback. Edge runtime is chosen to match Cloudflare Workers semantics (Web Request/Response, no Node built-ins) so src/api/** and src/lib/** run here unmodified.

headers.//comment: API responses are per-user and time-sensitive (live weather/AQI). A CDN cache here would serve one twin's numbers to another.

//rewrites: The SPA fallback deliberately EXCLUDES /api/* and /static/*. Rewriting /api/* to index.html made the static host answer the dashboard's probe with 200 + HTML, so core.js had to parse HTML as JSON before it could reject it — and it would now also shadow the Edge Function above. Excluding the prefix lets the function serve /api/*, and on a host without it the request 404s immediately, which is the fastest possible handoff to the in-browser local engine. /static/* is excluded so a genuinely missing asset 404s instead of silently returning the landing page.
